Associated fee: USD 5.00 for each 100 ADSs (or portion thereof) evidenced by the new ADRs delivered

Associated fee: USD 5.00 for each 100 ADSs (or portion thereof) evidenced by the ADRs surrendered

Associated fee: USD 5.00 for each 100 ADSs (or portion thereof)

Depository actions: Transfers, combining or grouping of depository receipts

Associated fee: Expenses payable at the sole discretion of the depository by billing holders or by deducting charges from one or more cash dividends or other cash distributions
